business_problem: BBVA needed to acquire and serve digital customers at scale while reducing onboarding friction, detecting fraud, and turning enterprise data into more targeted sales and service decisions across markets.
solution_summary: Accenture helped BBVA build a digital sales and engagement model that combines cloud, data, and AI across onboarding, analytics, and personalized outreach. The bank uses AI-based facial recognition and text analytics inside its mobile onboarding flow to verify applicants in minutes while connecting to external data sources for fraud detection. Behind that customer-facing layer, bank-wide data, predictive analytics, and business intelligence provide a unified view of profitability and likely behavior for individual customers. BBVA is also creating a new global data platform on Amazon Web Services so business units can process and analyze data more efficiently across markets. The resulting sales model joins customer-journey data, paid media, SEO, marketing automation, analytics, and content production to prioritize acquisition and cross-sell actions. By pairing AI verification with predictive analytics and a cloud-scale data platform, BBVA created a digital banking operating model that is faster, more personalized, and easier to expand internationally.

data_flow: Customer applications begin in BBVA's mobile onboarding flow, where facial recognition, text analytics, and external data checks verify identity and flag fraud risk. The resulting customer and interaction data then feeds the bank's broader data platform and predictive analytics environment to drive digital sales, cross-sell, and market-expansion decisions.
business_outcome: BBVA shortened onboarding, increased the share of digitally acquired sales, improved fraud controls, and created a more targeted customer-growth model that scales across new and existing markets.
